scope: Comparison manufacturer only; do not transfer these thresholds or timing limits to Intel I8282 or the specimen.
interpretation: NEC explicitly labels enable departures from the 1.5-V released bias. Intel AFN-01413B explicitly labels disable departures but not corresponding enable thresholds. Resolve the Intel measurement convention before applying an electrical enable acceptance test; do not assume a transition to final VOH minus 0.1 V or VOL plus 0.1 V.

earlierIntelRevision.grade: Commercial 8282/8283, 0 to 70 degrees Celsius; not the I8282 industrial profile
earlierIntelRevision.finding: Figure 4 labels the disable departure levels but supplies no separate enable departure voltage; its general 1.5-V timing convention does not resolve the released-output bias ambiguity. Do not infer the NEC 1.6/1.4-V thresholds. The switching load also differs from AFN-01413B, so neither load nor commercial timing limits replace the industrial contract.
